calismalar.baslik: Large Language Models for Telecom: Forthcoming Impact on the Industry
calismalar.gerekce: An early agenda-setting paper that lays out where LLMs can be used in telecom network management and optimization, and the open problems that come with them.

calismalar.baslik: Large Language Model (LLM) for Telecommunications: A Comprehensive Survey on Principles, Key Techniques, and Opportunities
calismalar.gerekce: A comprehensive survey that organizes LLM principles, adaptation techniques and wireless optimization uses, along with the open challenges.

calismalar.baslik: NetLLM: Adapting Large Language Models for Networking
calismalar.gerekce: Shows a general framework for adapting LLMs to networking decision tasks such as scheduling and adaptive bitrate.

calismalar.baslik: Large Language Model Enhanced Multi-Agent Systems for 6G Communications
calismalar.gerekce: Proposes a multi-agent LLM architecture for 6G communication design and optimization, with a semantic communication case study.

calismalar.baslik: LLM-Empowered Resource Allocation in Wireless Communications Systems
calismalar.gerekce: One of the first studies to solve wireless resource allocation directly with an LLM through few-shot in-context learning.

calismalar.baslik: Large Language Model (LLM)-enabled In-context Learning for Wireless Network Optimization: A Case Study of Power Control
calismalar.gerekce: Shows that base-station power control can be done with in-context learning and no retraining.

calismalar.baslik: Large Language Models as Optimizers
calismalar.gerekce: Introduces the OPRO paradigm of using an LLM as a black-box optimizer, which became the methodological basis for LLM-driven optimization in wireless networks.

calismalar.baslik: Large Language Models for Networking: Applications, Enabling Techniques, and Challenges
calismalar.gerekce: Sets out the ChatNet framework and the open problems for automating network planning and management with LLMs.

calismalar.baslik: WirelessLLM: Empowering Large Language Models Towards Wireless Intelligence
calismalar.gerekce: Proposes adapting LLMs to wireless problems through knowledge alignment, fusion and evolution.

calismalar.baslik: Large Multi-Modal Models (LMMs) as Universal Foundation Models for AI-Native Wireless Systems
calismalar.gerekce: Sets a vision of multimodal, grounded and causal-reasoning foundation models for AI-native 6G.

calismalar.baslik: When Large Language Model Agents Meet 6G Networks: Perception, Grounding, and Alignment
calismalar.gerekce: Discusses deploying LLM agents in 6G networks, edge-cloud collaboration, and the grounding and alignment problems that remain open.

calismalar.baslik: Large Language Models Empowered Autonomous Edge AI for Connected Intelligence
calismalar.gerekce: Shows how LLMs can autonomously plan and optimize edge AI workflows in 6G.

calismalar.baslik: Pushing Large Language Models to the 6G Edge: Vision, Challenges, and Opportunities
calismalar.gerekce: Covers how to train and run LLMs at the 6G edge and the resource-management problems this raises.

calismalar.baslik: Large Generative AI Models for Telecom: The Next Big Thing?
calismalar.gerekce: An early vision paper on how large generative AI models could enable self-managing telecom networks.

calismalar.baslik: TelecomGPT: A Framework to Build Telecom-Specific Large Language Models
calismalar.gerekce: Presents a pipeline and benchmarks for building telecom-domain-specific LLMs.

calismalar.baslik: TeleQnA: A Benchmark Dataset to Assess Large Language Models Telecommunications Knowledge
calismalar.gerekce: The first widely used benchmark for measuring how much telecom knowledge LLMs have.

calismalar.baslik: Telco-RAG: Navigating the Challenges of Retrieval-Augmented Language Models for Telecommunications
calismalar.gerekce: Addresses grounding LLMs in standards documents such as 3GPP through retrieval-augmented generation.

calismalar.baslik: LLM4CP: Adapting Large Language Models for Channel Prediction
calismalar.gerekce: Shows that a pretrained LLM can be adapted to a physical-layer task (channel prediction) for MIMO-OFDM.

calismalar.baslik: Large Language Model (LLM)-enabled Graphs in Dynamic Networking
calismalar.gerekce: Proposes a two-stage LLM+GNN design in which the LLM produces the UAV trajectory and a GNN allocates the communication resources.

calismalar.baslik: Large Language Models for UAVs: Current State and Pathways to the Future
calismalar.gerekce: Reviews LLM use for UAV autonomy, trajectory planning and communication, along with the open problems.

calismalar.baslik: Generative AI Agents with Large Language Model for Satellite Networks via a Mixture of Experts Transmission
calismalar.gerekce: Uses LLM agents to model and optimize satellite communication transmission strategies.

calismalar.baslik: Generative AI Agent for Next-Generation MIMO Design: Fundamentals, Challenges, and Vision
calismalar.gerekce: Proposes an LLM-based agent for MIMO system design and performance analysis.

calismalar.baslik: Large Language Model as a Catalyst: A Paradigm Shift in Base Station Siting Optimization
calismalar.gerekce: Shows how LLMs and prompt optimization can be used to solve the base-station siting problem.

calismalar.baslik: WirelessAgent: Large Language Model Agents for Intelligent Wireless Networks
calismalar.gerekce: Presents an LLM agent framework with perception, memory, planning and action modules for tasks such as network slicing.

calismalar.baslik: Large Language Models for Wireless Networks: An Overview from the Prompt Engineering Perspective
calismalar.gerekce: Organizes prompt-engineering methods for wireless network optimization, including iterative prompting.

calismalar.baslik: Hermes: A Large Language Model Framework on the Journey to Autonomous Networks
calismalar.gerekce: Proposes autonomous network management in which LLM agent chains build network digital-twin blueprints.

calismalar.baslik: Survey on Large Language Model-Enhanced Reinforcement Learning: Concept, Taxonomy, and Methods
calismalar.gerekce: A taxonomy of LLM-enhanced RL approaches that underpins hybrid LLM+DRL resource allocation methods in wireless.

calismalar.baslik: Prompting Wireless Networks: Reinforced In-Context Learning for Power Control
calismalar.gerekce: Combines reinforced in-context learning with power control and reports performance comparable to DRL.

calismalar.baslik: A New Paradigm of User-Centric Wireless Communication Driven by Large Language Models
calismalar.gerekce: Proposes user-centric wireless management in which the LLM formulates and solves power allocation as an optimization problem.

calismalar.baslik: LLM-Guided Open RAN: Empowering Hierarchical RAN Intelligent Control
calismalar.gerekce: Proposes a hierarchical O-RAN controller in which the LLM gives strategic guidance and RL makes the low-latency decisions.
